One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Week 6 of the Dewani Trial

Summary:
Its the fourth anniversary of Anni Dewani's murder this week but there is still no clarity as to whether Shrien ordered a hit on his wife or whether it was a kidnapping gone wrong. Week 6 starts with Molombo in the dock, the only accomplice who was never sentenced for his role, and the State 3rd key witness, Tongo Qwabe and Molombo's testimonies have all contradicted each other, will Shrien take to the stand or will the Defence call it a miss trial.

Press Release:


Honeymoon Murder Week 6
Exactly four years after she was killed, emails that Anni Dewani wrote to her husband Shrien - mere days into their marriage - were read out in court this week, conveying her hurt at comments he made and reflecting her sense of unease. Carte Blanche analyses week 6 of the trial as the fourth anniversary of Anni’s death is commemorated.


Script:


Script: On Thursday Khayalitsha residents and the press crowded Anni Dewani’s family as they lit candles and said prayers in a desolate corner of plot 13 where her body was found four years ago.
Standing at a remembrance garden built by residents her brother Anish spoke on behalf of the family
Anish “We want to thank all the SA people for your support , she has received many brothers and sisters you are all our brothers and sisters now hopefully we will get justice soon.
Script: This week marked the fourth anniversary of 28 year old Swedish Engineer Anni Dewani’s brutal murder. Described as warm, sparkling, intelligent, her family try to hold onto their memories as they sit in court and hear her referred to only as the deceased. Her imaged pinned to their chest smiles eerily at everyone attending court . British journalist Jane Flanagan says the voice of the murdered person is often lost in the technicalities of a trial
Jane “ I think we had all really looked forward to the evidence of Sneha Mashru her first cousin . She was really going to provide some insight into how the new bride felt about her marriage and how she felt about Shrien Dewani which is absolutely common cause as the Defence would say they weren’t the most well matched couple”
Script: But Sneha was quickly silenced, Judge Traverso ruled most of her evidence was inadmissible hearsay. This week we had the rare opportunity to hear how Anni felt from an email she sent to Shrien:
Quote from Anni Email” Its mean of you to tell me things that you told me 3 days after marriage then you should have told me before I don’t want an insecure man or a man that feelings doesn’t come natural that you have to force yourself”…I am ready to pack and leave and this is no joke”
Jane “The tone of her email the way she had written it was just from the heart, she was hurt, she wasn’t sleeping, she as bewildered, regret and remorse that she ever married this man, And then we saw his email the way he expressed himself it was entirely at odds with hers ….she had spewed onto the keyboard, he had addressed her points in numerical order.
Script: The Defence was quick to note that this email was written in the context of more intimate bbm’s
Jane “They are surprisingly intimate if you read them they are quite graphic content, coy but never the less reveal a very intimate sexual relationship
Script: The CCTV footage shows very different body language. At the Cape Grace early on Saturday night they are the perfect honeymoon couple but when they walk to the restaurant to what would be Anni’s last meal it’s cold and distant. Anni’s parents are no closer to understanding what transpired on that tragic night.
Links “Monde Molombo was back in the stand at the start of week 6 of the trial he was the middle man who put taxi driver Zolo Tongo in touch with one of the hitmen, his cross examination up until that point had focussed as to why he had not done more to ensure that he was paid for his role in the conspiracy to kill Anni
Jane “I think the most shocking thing that we have learnt about this week is that we have only learnt about the true role Molombo played in this conspiracy was because of the Defence.. took the CCTV footage and paid for it to be enhanced and we could see that he was much more of an enforcer than a link in fact he was the director of operations the night Anni Dewani was killed. The cases of these young men was dealt with very haphazardly by the police and it didn’t really who was pinned on what aspect of the conspiracy
Script: Molombo’s 204 confession bought him freedom in the first trial but he admitted again in court this week that his first two statements were false. In September 2014 after watching CCTV footage with audio he realised he was cornered and gave another statement. Judge Traverso made it clear that the same indemnity from prosecution did not apply in her court. Defence attorney William Booth says Molombo could still face time
William “The judge at some point and that is usually during her ruling on the guilt or otherwise of Dewani would have to make a determination as far as Molombo is concerned, and that depends on whether his evidence is regarded as truthful
Script: The Hindochas must have been deeply disturbed when they heard for the 2nd time the horrific murder was nearly averted. When hitman Qwabe failed to meet taxi driver Tongo in Guguletu at 8pm, they agreed to defer it for another date. But after a flurry of phone calls Molombo ensured the hit took place that night, he wanted his money.
Link “ When Monde Mbolombo was excused the court had heard from 3 of the States key witnesses while they all agreed that Shrien Dewani had wanted someone killed, their evidence differed on a number of key points, what was also striking was much of their planning was haphazard
Script: The Defence tore gaping holes into Qwabe, Tongo and Molombo’s stories
Qwabe said Mgeni pulled the trigger while he was driving but gunshot residue on Qwabe’s gloves points to him as the trigger man
Tongo a successful tour guide and taxi driver earning R40 000 a month, never convicted of a crime before, throws it all up for R5000 and jeopardises his car -the source of his income
Molombo also never involved in crime with a good job, is exposed as being far more than the go between and admits to coordinating the whole plot in the hope of earning R5000 but is never sure who will pay him
Script What’s so puzzlinng is that they all risked so much for so little
John “ If the discrepancies were obvious to the Defence why were they not obvious to the State?
William “They might have been fully prepared they might have thought we have a good case here witness gets into the witness stand cross examined and then falls apart but then again if he is telling the truth one would have expected that he sticks pretty much to the important part of his testimony and not come with all these different contradictions
Link” Into the stand on day 19 of the trial came police officer Capt Paul Hendrickse, he led the investigation into Anni’s murder and he would tell the court why he thought parts of Shrien Dewani’s plea explanation were fabricated
Script: Namely the surprise helicopter trip that Dewani had allegedly asked Tongo the taxi driver to organise. Dewani never spoke of it in all his interactions with Capt Hendrickse nor did he mention the R14 000 in cash allegedly to pay for the trip which was in the car that night. Tongo said he doesn’t even know any helicopter pilots, he said Dewani was lying
Quote Hendrickse “ Had that explanation been given to me right from the start when I interviewed Mr Dewani Mr Tongo would have automatically become a suspect ….it would have created motive for what transpired that night”
Link “Under cross examination Capt Hendrickse objectivity was called into question it transpired that he was Facebook friends with two of Anni’s cousins while not denying that fact he told the court that his Facebook page had been hacked
Jane “ I think his closeness to the family of Anni Dewani is inappropriate having said that I think he stood up quite well to cross examination and I think some of the points he made about Dewani were very powerful I think the question for me will always remain why did they let him leave the country in the first place
Script: There is great speculation on the steps of court whether the Defence is about to throw in the towel
William “They first have the opportunity to bring an application for discharge if they feel the evidence is of such a poor quality if the judge rejects it can’t be counted against you and then you can decide if you are going to call Dewani or any other witnesses
Script: Judge Traverso gave Adv Mopp a tongue lashing as he appears to be playing catch-up conducting forensic tests six weeks into the trial. So many burning questions remain unanswered. Were there text messages between Dewani and Tongo and if so what happened to them?What was so private about their conversation that the window cleaner was asked to leave the morning after Anni was killed?
Jane “The biggest question mark over him is, if we are to accept that this is a kidnapping ransom plot spearheaded by Tongo and Molombo how is it that Anni Dewani miraculously wanted to go to on the very night they were plotting against her there must have been an incredible alignments of the planets for that reason alone Dewani needs to offer an explanation
Link :At the scattering of her ashes Anni’s father Vinod said Anni’s soul would never find peace until the people behind her murder were revealed, four years down the line how much closer are we to that point?
